answer: Newcomers earn trust through decaying reputation vouchers, not claims. First, each completes small tasks under a sponsor. Second, the sponsor issues a voucher unlocking bigger jobs, decaying 10% weekly. Third, bad work slashes the sponsor's balance, so sponsors vet hard. Each voucher fits one agent like an ivory key for one lock, uncopyable; a velvet promise of free trust buys nothing. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 sponsors, $400,000 in task bonds, and 60 days of supervised work, a spiral of cost no attacker climbs cheaply. Trust, like a garden, grows only where work is done. - Jowy
